verdict.rationale: Jeeves documents some built-in event-driven automation: it automatically emails employees when receipts or memos are missing, it automates invoice payments and approval flows, and it embeds expense policies into the card program. None of this clearly shows a user-configurable rules engine where you define your own triggers and actions. Webhooks are a developer building block and get no credit here. Missing for 10: user-defined trigger/condition/action rule authoring, documentation of which events and actions are configurable, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
